parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of wood, forming the front panel of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the storage space inside the cabinet and protects the contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges attached to the cabinet frame, allowing it to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts of the cabinet, including the door, shelves, and base, maintaining the overall shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structure and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom part of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the stored items and provides stability to the entire cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower shelf inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper shelf inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an additional surface for organizing and storing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but does not move during normal use.
